# Moved: `low-token-policy.md`

This file was renamed in v1.0.0. The current version is **`handoff-density-policy.md`** in this same `references/` directory. Read that instead; it is the authoritative copy.

The rename went with a change of premise, not just a name. Context is no longer scarce, so the rule is no longer 'send less'. It is 'send the right thing': a handoff is judged on whether it removes ambiguity, not on how short it is.

This pointer exists so forks and vendored copies keep resolving through one release cycle. It is removed in v1.1.0.
